subject: Map Kickoff: Velenia / Redwood Inference - Draft MAP and timeline options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Raman <asha.raman@velenia.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Map Kickoff: Velenia / Redwood Inference - Draft MAP and timeline options

Hi Asha —

Thanks again for the time earlier today. I enjoyed the discussion and appreciate the clarity on Velenia's top priorities (low-latency inference for search, audit logging, and a predictable cost model for monthly usage). Per our call, I’m sharing an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft to get the kickoff moving. The attached workbook contains:

- Proposed milestones (Discovery -> Pilot -> Security Review -> Production Rollout)
- Suggested owners (Redwood vs. Velenia) for each milestone
- Dependencies and open items (data access, SOC 2 evidence, procurement timeline)
- Two timeline options: Accelerated (8 weeks) and Standard (14 weeks) with target close dates

Action items / asks:
1) Please review the attached MAP and confirm the primary stakeholders on your side for each milestone (we currently have you listed for Pilot testing and procurement@velenia.com for contracting).
2) Tell us which timeline you prefer (Accelerated vs. Standard) or propose an alternate target close date.
3) Any immediate blockers we should surface to our security/compliance team now (e.g., specific evidence request, legal clauses)?

I copied Rachel from our CS team; she’ll own the pilot coordination and test plan with you. If it’s helpful, we can lock a 30-minute MAP-owners kickoff next week.

Attachment: Velenia_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx [attachment stub: application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 72KB]

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

P.S. quick note: our pilot SLA includes a 99.9% uptime target for dedicated pools; we can scope that explicitly in the MAP if you want it reflected in milestones.

From: Asha Raman <asha.raman@velenia.com>

Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Map Kickoff: Velenia / Redwood Inference - Draft MAP and timeline options

Thanks Marissa — great to meet earlier.

I reviewed the MAP draft quickly and this looks like a good starting point. A few notes from Velenia's side:

- Stakeholders: Please add Priya Natarajan (priya.natarajan@velenia.com) as Owner for Security Review; she’ll lead our SOC 2 and encryption requirements. I’ll remain the pilot contact and Asha (procurement) will be looped for contracting.
- Timeline: Standard (14 weeks) looks more realistic given our internal procurement cadence, but we’d like to start discovery immediately and aim to complete Pilot objectives within 6 weeks of kickoff.
- Dependencies: We will need a short data access agreement before you receive sample data; procurement will push for that language.

Can you update the MAP with these changes and re-send? Also confirm whether Redwood can provide a short appendix with the SOC 2 artifact checklist for our Security Review.

Best,
Asha Raman
Head of Search Engineering
Velenia
asha.raman@velenia.com
